title: Redesign Explosion page as Golden Hour Ruin: bright renderer, mobile framing, card copy
Fix per-part destruction: ghost voxels removed by world_version render sync, condemned members stop bearing load
summary: Owner report: broken parts floated mid-air or stayed visually intact, destruction looked group-quantized. Two verified defects. (1) Web: the structure InstancedMesh was only rebuilt on blast/restore/load, never in the rAF loop, so voxels removed by doom-timer breaks (break_ready -> world_version bump) kept rendering as stale boxes at old positions — red ghosts (painted at click time) = floating fragments, original-colored ghosts (condemned in later re-solve waves) = visually intact. Fix: frame loop now rebuilds the mesh whenever core.stats.worldVersion moves (gated on !building; restore syncs the version). (2) Core: support_pass/load_pass flooded through doomed==1 voxels, so side branches hanging off a stress-condemned member stayed supported until it physically broke, unrolling level by level. Fix: doomed voxels no longer seed or route support/load, and solve() iterates support->load->failure to a fixpoint (cap H+2; converges — doom sticky, loads only drop), so the whole transitive doom set gets its own timers in one solve. Crack scheduler, collapse cam, calibration and frozen ABI untouched. Verified: cargo wasm build clean; ffi-smoke 40/40 (peaks 65.9%/73.1%, zero doomed both-banks, determinism, never-grow); new part-fall-verify.mjs 1366/1366 — instance list mirrors filled at every step through 158 doom-break version bumps, no stragglers after settle; tsc --noEmit clean incl. detonate.ts. Browser suite unrun on this machine (no Chrome; CHROME_PATH to enable).

Explosion fresh start: Ember Lantern replaces the demolition lab; dark page shell restored
summary: Owner verdict: the per-part destruction bug persisted through two verified fix rounds, so the demolition lab was retired rather than fixed again. New concept from the delegated chat model (LOCKED SPEC 'Ember Lantern'): a paper-lantern moon of 600 shards on one InstancedMesh — shards are re-posed between rest/flight, never created or destroyed, so the rendered view is a pure function of one state array and a mid-air ghost is unrepresentable (no timers, no solver, no version counter, no second mesh). Same-frame detonation, auto flashpoint bloom (engagements counter), one-click restore easing shards home. TypeScript-only: the wasm core and physics-core.ts are retired from the render path (files kept). Page shell restored to the owner-liked dark ink look (#0b1317 + locked gradient stage + grid mask). Integration adjustments: shards use MeshBasicMaterial (a center PointLight cannot light outward faces of a convex shard sphere — standard material rendered the lantern near-black), added a ground disc so the rest plane is visible, DIST_MIN 3.2->4.3 (sphere was ~93% of frame height on wide desktops), added a 'spent' phase and per-shard base heat variance. Browser suite rewritten to the new contract; browser unrun on this machine (no Chrome/Chromium found); tsc + vite build green.
